title: Fill the Last Square
setup: White's bishop on h3 has its own pawn on g2 behind it and its own rook on f1 beyond that.
hint: White's own pieces block one diagonal completely. The other one starts on a square your h-pawn already guards.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{g4}} leaves the bishop with nothing: g2 is White's pawn, f1 its rook, and the pawn now on g4 is guarded by h5. White can only shed a piece, and ...gxh3 collects it next move. You trap a bishop by filling squares, not by chasing it.
